data.title: W / 维什戴尔 · 幕布后的一眼
data.description: 她掀开幕布，回头朝你勾了勾手指。等你靠近，她才压低声音说，这次的秘密出口只带你走。
data.action: 掀幕回眸，勾手示意跟上
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: Peering out from behind a heavy dark velvet stage curtain, W crooks a gloved finger to beckon the viewer into the quiet backstage area of the theater with a sly, conspiratorial smile. Beams of dramatic amber stage lights spill past the draped fabric, creating bold rim lighting along her silhouette and illuminating stage trusses and lighting rigs in the warm spill of ambient light.
